$
    ``values`` maps reserved IDs to their little-endian decoded integers.$
    Raises WireError on any leaf range violation.  Returns (inputs, model)$
    where inputs is a parameter-name dict and model is the result value or$
    None for a void result.$
    """$
    counter = [0]$
$
    def take():$
        v = values[counter[0]]$
        counter[0] += 1$
        return v$
$
    def visit(tname):$
            return$
        d = types.defs[tname]$
        kind = d.kind$
        if kind == 'alias':$
            return visit(d.target)$
        if kind == 'bool':$
            v = take()$
            if v not in (0, 1):$
                raise WireError('bool out of range')$
            return v == 1$
        if kind == 'char':$
            return chr(take())$
        if kind == 'int':$
            v = take()$
            if v >= (1 << d.bits):$
                raise WireError('int padding bits set')$
            return v$
